relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Perfusion of CGRP (100 nM) for 4–8 min increased the AP discharges per pulse from 6.13 ± 0.52 to 11.75 ± 1.59

relationships.subject: BIBN 4096BS
relationships.evidence_quote: When the non-peptide antagonist for CGRP receptors, BIBN 4096BS (also called olcegepant; 10 µM), was applied 17–20 min before CGRP, no change in cell excitability was observed following CGRP

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of CGRP at 100 nM significantly increased the frequency of spEPSCs from 2.63 ± 0.52 Hz to 3.85 ± 0.86 Hz

relationships.subject: nifedipine
relationships.evidence_quote: pre-treating Sp5C superficial neurons with nifedipine successfully blocked the effects of CGRP on membrane potential, tonic discharges, threshold for spike initiation and AHP

key_findings: CGRP enhances tonic firing and excitatory synaptic drive onto Sp5C superficial neurons via pre- and postsynaptic actions, blocked by BIBN 4096BS
The direct postsynaptic effect of CGRP is nifedipine-sensitive, implicating L-type calcium channels
